messages:
Maya (Product): Heads up — planning sync: Q3 hosted API priorities. Need to decide tradeoffs across chat/completions/embeddings/rerank. Quick thread to capture asks.
James (PM): Key asks from PM side: 1) lower-cost embeddings for index use cases, 2) clearer latency SLOs for chat (p50/p95). Need concrete numbers for roadmap.
Chris (Customer Success): FYI, three customers asked for batch-embedding bulk upload + progress webhook. Also one enterprise customer pushing for deterministic rerank scoring.
Rohan (Engineering): Engineering constraints: limited dedicated capacity next quarter; autoscaling warm-up cost is the blocker. If we push embeddings batching we can offset GPU usage peaks.
Lina (Eng-ML): ML note: quantized models drop quality on rerank tests (nDCG ~ -0.02). Need an eval gate and a canary with A/B. Proposing an 'embeddings-lite' profile optimized for throughput/cost.
James (PM): @Rohan can we commit to an embeddings-lite variant that uses FP16 + int8 blend? Rough ETA?
Rohan (Engineering): ETA ~6 weeks if we prioritize the kernel/packing work now. But that shifts chat continuous-batching improvements by ~3 weeks.
Maya (Product): Decision needed: prioritize embeddings-cost (direct customer revenue) vs chat latency (PLG retention). Propose we scope embeddings-lite as a smaller initiative: M1 feature-gate + canary, M2 full rollout.
Chris (Customer Success): Customers will accept canary for embeddings if we offer rate-limited bulk ingest + S3-compatible upload + progress webhook. That's the minimal launch criteria from CS.
Maya (Product): Launch criteria draft:
```
- embeddings-lite: >=30% token cost reduction vs baseline
- quality: delta nDCG <= 0.01 vs full model
- infra: canary at 10% traffic and progress webhook implemented
- docs + SDK sample for bulk flows
```
Can everyone ack or suggest changes?
Lina (Eng-ML): Ack to the flow but suggest quality delta target be <= 0.02 given current eval variance. 0.01 might be too strict.
Rohan (Engineering): Ack infra. ETA recap: 6w for model+kernel, +2w for canary infra and webhook. We can parallelize SDK docs in week 6.
James (PM): I'll rework the PRD to reflect 2-phase rollout and include customer SLAs/phasing. Will add example curl + S3 flow.
Maya (Product): :thumbsup: Let's treat chat latency improvements as a follow-on slice. If no objections we'll move embeddings-lite to Q3 committed and chat latency to Q4.
Chris (Customer Success): No objections from CS; will surface prioritized customer list and sample datasets for the canary.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Next product planning review scheduled at 2001234600 — agenda item 'embeddings-lite' added.
